mapper.select: /* UserMapper.retrieveUserInfoByKey */ SELECT A.USER_ID, A.DEPT_CD, A.USER_NM, B.DEPT_NM FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_USER A LEFT JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_DEPT B ON A.DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

/* UserMapper.retrieveRoleIdList */ SELECT A.ROLE_ID FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_USER_ROLE A INNER JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_ROLE B ON A.ROLE_ID = B.ROLE_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND B.TASK_ID = 'PM' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.ROLE_ID
